metaDescription: Meet the team behind Thistle Architecture, commercial conversion specialists delivering data-driven feasibility across the UK.

hero.label: About
hero.heading: A Feasibility-First Architectural Practice.
hero.description: We analyse the data, so the answer is accurate and the wait is short. We work with developers and high-end residential clients on retrofit, conversion, and the reuse of existing buildings.

intro.heading: An Architecture Practice,
intro.imageAlt: The Thistle Architecture team working together in the studio, reviewing plans on laptops and tablets
intro.body1: Thistle Architecture tests whether a building can become something more valuable, then designs and delivers the answer. Every scheme starts with the numbers, the planning policy, and the existing structure, so you know whether a deal stacks up before you commit to it.
intro.body2: Thistle Architecture is part of the Thistle Group, alongside HMO Designers and HMO Checker. Some of the team also develop and invest in the same kinds of buildings our clients buy, which sharpens the advice, but it supports the architecture, it doesn't replace it.

themes.title: Feasibility First
themes.body: Every project starts with the same question: does this actually work? We answer it with a fixed-fee feasibility before a single line is drawn.

themes.title: Existing Buildings & Retrofit
themes.body: Most of what we do is testing and reusing what's already there, not building on a clean slate.

themes.title: Data-Informed Decisions
themes.body: Planning history, policy, comparables and viability, checked before judgement is applied, not instead of it.

themes.title: Developer-Led, Commercially Aware Design
themes.body: We design with the numbers in view throughout, not as a check at the end.

themes.title: One Team Through Delivery
themes.body: The person who runs your feasibility is the designer you keep working with through planning and delivery.

members.name: Edward Kercher
members.contribution: Sets the commercial and technical standard every feasibility is judged against, from £50,000 refurbishments to £20m construction management. Founded the Thistle Group, so the developer's perspective is built into how the practice works, not bolted on afterwards.

members.name: Kaan Taskin
members.contribution: Kaan runs every feasibility from the first sketch scheme to sign-off, and is the designer most clients work with through planning. He leads the planning process across the practice, managing projects from feasibility to submission, coordinating consultants and acting as the quality check before anything goes to a council. He joined Thistle in 2024 after five years across residential and HMO work, from deal sourcing through to submission, and holds a BArch in Architecture.

members.name: Jan Kercher
members.contribution: Jan leads interior design across the Thistle Group, making sure every scheme is finished to a demanding standard once the architecture is settled. She produces the room-by-room mood boards, specifications and interior design packs for co-living, HMO and residential projects, and works alongside the design team from feasibility so the interiors are planned in rather than added at the end. She brings 25 years across interior design, graphic design and brand management, and holds an HND in Design and is an Associate of the CIPD.

members.name: Adouj Abu Saadeh
members.contribution: Brings international practice experience in Turkey, Azerbaijan, and the UAE to the design team, since moving to the UK.
members.credential: BA Architecture, Bilkent University (High Honours, 2019); LEED Green Associate

members.name: Seyma Dilber
members.contribution: Seyma takes projects from the first survey through design and into the planning and technical stages, producing the planning drawings and technical packages that carry a scheme from consent to site. She has six years across residential and HMO work, commercial surveying, design and planning in the UK, and holds a BSc in Architecture and an MA in Interior Design.

members.name: Beverley Gibbs
members.contribution: Looks after the finance and admin that keeps every project on track behind the scenes, with over 20 years of practice and studio management experience.

members.name: Jodi Edgley
members.contribution:
Leads the first conversation behind every feasibility, gathering the project details and understanding the client’s commercial goals before the design team begins. 

Commercial-to-residential and HMO investment specialist
members.credential: 10 years in estate agency, NAEA qualified

closing.heading: Data First, Then Drawings.
closing.body: Most practices design first and worry about viability later. We do it the other way round. We analyse the data first, which makes the answer more accurate and cuts the time it takes to get it. The team that runs your feasibility stays with you through sketch scheme, planning, and delivery, so nothing is lost in handover.
